article.headline: Erims scores 33 as Grambling defeats Ecclesia 126-45
article.description: — Imoh Erims’ 33 points led Grambling over Ecclesia 126-45 on Monday.
article.linkText: Erims scores 33 as Grambling defeats Ecclesia 126-45
article.story: GRAMBLING, La. -- — Imoh Erims’ 33 points led Grambling over Ecclesia 126-45 on Monday. Erims added 11 rebounds and three steals for the Tigers (2-3). Antonio Shannon scored 14 points while going 5 of 9 (4 for 8 from 3-point range), and added six rebounds. Colin Byrd had 14 points and went 5 of 8 from the field (2 for 4 from 3-point range). Joshua Ourigou led the way for the Royals with 12 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
